messages.subject: [genoPlotR-help] genoplotR
messages.body_plain:
Dear Ingrid Meyer,

You?ll find some info in section 4 of the ?getting started? page (http://genoplotr.r-forge.r-project.org/vignette.php). 
Typically, genomes/chromosomes/plasmids are formatted under EMBL or Genbank files. I assume you are familiar with these formats, which are offered by both NCBI and EMBL. Reading functions in genoPlotR are read_dna_seg_from_genbank and read_dna_seg_from_embl, respectively.

For comparisons, the tabular output of blast (-outfmt 6) can be read directly read (read_comparison_from_blast). Alternatively, you can create your own tab files, which should contain at least the columns start1, end1, start2, end2. More info in the specific help pages (type ?read_comparison_from_blast in R).

Hope that helps,

Lionel
